Kimberly / Mina —

Thanks, Sarah. Kim & Mina, quick ask: this hire is scoped as a senior individual contributor focused on runtime release management for our KV/cache subsystem (low-latency inference path). We need two approvals: (1) comp band signoff (base + equity) to extend the offer; (2) an additional IC slot to hire concurrently (we've exhausted the current quarter's allocation).

Rationale highlights:
- Immediate customer demand (Vortex) requires a release lead to guarantee stability for upcoming 8k token workload.
- Reduces on-call churn on existing runtime SREs by ~30% per our estimate.
- Expected $/token cost savings by 10% once KV-cache improvements land.

Proposed comp: base $210k-$230k, RSU 30k 4yr, one-time sign-on up to $30k. I've included a draft offer packet as an attachment.

Can we get band + slot confirmation by EOD Monday so Greenlight can issue?

—Karthik
